data.intent: Metric 4: unit tests for the release-day comparison and headline (exact fixtures)

decisions.chosen: plain average of the per-activity percent changes
decisions.detail: the Day-Off Index averages its phrases' changes the same way; counts differ by 10x between PRs and commits, so changes are averaged, not counts
fct_day_off_index: an average over fewer parts is a different number

decisions.decision: What release day is compared with
decisions.chosen: the same weekday a week before (Thu 12 Nov 2026); a median when github_baseline_weeks > 1
decisions.detail: profiled (.dex/review/154): strong weekly cycle, and PRs opened grew from 1.15M (22 Oct) to 1.35M (12 Nov) on Thursdays, so older weeks understate a normal 19 Nov; commits carry bulk-import spikes (16.4M on 5 Nov vs ~12.9M), hence a median for longer baselines. No US holiday on 12 Nov

decisions.decision: A baseline day without a count
decisions.detail: an average over fewer days would be a different baseline

fct_github_release_day.content:
name: fct_github_release_day
description: 'Metric 4 headline: the average of the activities'' release-day changes, one row per release day, with its breakdown. Population: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).'
model: ref('fct_github_release_day')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: release_day
entities:
  - name: release_day_key
    type: primary
    expr: release_day_key
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: activities_total
    agg: max
    expr: activities_total
    description: Activities in the breakdown.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: activities_available
    agg: max
    expr: activities_available
    description: Activities with a change.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: github_release_day_change
    agg: max
    expr: github_release_day_change
    description: Average of the activities' changes, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL until every activity has a change.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).
      assumptions:
        - decision: How the activities combine
          chosen: plain average of the per-activity percent changes
          evidence: precedent
          detail: the Day-Off Index averages its phrases' changes the same way; counts differ by 10x between PRs and commits, so changes are averaged, not counts
          column: github_release_day_change
        - decision: An activity not yet available
          chosen: headline NULL
          evidence: precedent
          detail: 'fct_day_off_index: an average over fewer parts is a different number'
          column: github_release_day_change

fct_github_release_day_activities.content:
name: fct_github_release_day_activities
description: 'Metric 4 breakdown: release day against the median of the same weekday in the weeks before it (canonical: the Thursday before), one row per activity. Population: One row per activity present in fct_github_daily, whether or not release day has been counted yet.'
model: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: release_day
entities:
  - name: activity
    type: primary
    expr: activity
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: GTA 6's release day (var github_release_day).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: baseline_days_found
    agg: max
    expr: baseline_days_found
    description: Baseline days with a count.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: days
          null_rule: never
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: baseline_count
    agg: max
    expr: baseline_count
    description: Median count over the baseline days (the day itself when there is one).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL when no baseline day has a count.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: release_day_count
    agg: max
    expr: release_day_count
    description: Count on release day. NULL until the day is over and counted.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          null_rule: NULL until release day has ended and been counted.
          additivity: non_additive
  - name: pct_change
    agg: max
    expr: pct_change
    description: Release day against the baseline average, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          null_rule: NULL unless release day and every baseline day have a count.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: One row per activity present in fct_github_daily, whether or not release day has been counted yet.
      assumptions:
        - decision: What release day is compared with
          chosen: the same weekday a week before (Thu 12 Nov 2026); a median when github_baseline_weeks > 1
          evidence: data
          detail: 'profiled (.dex/review/154): strong weekly cycle, and PRs opened grew from 1.15M (22 Oct) to 1.35M (12 Nov) on Thursdays, so older weeks understate a normal 19 Nov; commits carry bulk-import spikes (16.4M on 5 Nov vs ~12.9M), hence a median for longer baselines. No US holiday on 12 Nov'
          column: baseline_count
        - decision: A baseline day without a count
          chosen: change NULL
          evidence: default
          detail: an average over fewer days would be a different baseline
          column: pct_change
